note: Post-UTME Current Affairs round 2 (Oct 2026): grows the CA bank from 235 to 500+ so heavy Post-UTME users get far more papers before repeats. All-new angles: state governors in office (terms past 2026), Rivers administrator, protocol order, legislative lists and constitutional staples, states-creation and republic history (OFN, WAI, SAP, NADECO, first newspaper/TV), economy institutions (PIA regulators, Gencos/Discos, Band A, mint, unicorns, ABP), 2023-2024 election facts, security agencies and founding years, zones/landmarks/airports/ports/dams, festivals and traditional rulers, Africa and world bodies, AFCON 2025 appeal ruling, CAF Awards 2025, D'Tigress five-peat, Paris 2024, entertainment firsts, and modern ICT (ChatGPT, USSD, 5G, Starlink, 2FA, ransomware, NDPA 2023). Facts verified October 2026; time-stamped items say so in the stem. No new university formats added - DELSU scrapped its post-UTME exam (2025) and UNIJOS/FUTMINNA/UNIUYO use online screening without published CBT formats, so they stay on the general format per the verification standard.
